column4: 你喜欢什么类型的电影？
column5: What type of film do you like?
column6: 类型 is a type or category: 电影类型 (a type of film), 这种类型 (this type). 类 is the shorter word.

column5: I bought two pears.
column6: 梨 is a pear. 苹果 is an apple and 橘子 is a tangerine.

column5: They got divorced last year.
column6: 离婚 is to divorce. It is a verb plus object, so it splits: 离了婚. 结婚 is to get married.

column5: My younger brother is three centimetres taller than me.
column6: 厘米 is a centimetre. It follows a number: 三厘米, 十厘米. 米 is a metre.

column5: He left his job last month.
column6: 离职 is to leave a job, by choice or when the job ends: 离职原因 (the reason for leaving). 辞职 is to resign.

column5: This theory is very famous.
column6: 理论 is a theory: 学理论 (to study theory), 理论和实际 (theory and practice).

column5: What is inside the box?
column6: 里头 means "inside", the same as 里面 but more casual: 房间里头, 里头有人.

column5: Please give your reason.
column6: 理由 is the reason you give for something: 有理由 (to have good grounds), 没有理由 (to have no reason). 原因 is the cause behind something.

column5: He pushes the door with force.
column6: 力 is strength or force: 用力 (to use force), 力气 (physical strength), 能力 (ability), 压力 (pressure). At the end of a word it makes abstract words: 想象力 (imagination).

column5: Please come back at once.
column6: 立即 means "immediately", a little more formal than 立刻: 立即行动 (to act at once).

column5: I am coming right away.
column6: 立刻 means "right away": 立刻去, 立刻明白 (to understand at once). It is the everyday form of 立即.

column5: The power of water is very great.
column6: 力量 is strength or power, of a body or a group: 力量很大 (very strong), 大家的力量 (everyone's strength).

column4: 这家公司今年的利润很高。
column5: This company's profit is very high this year.
column6: 利润 is the money left after costs: 利润很高 (a high profit), 利润下降 (profits fall).

column5: Everyone's interests are very important.
column6: 利益 is benefit or advantage for a person or group: 个人利益 (personal interest), 共同利益 (common interests).

column3: to use; to make use of
column5: We need to make good use of our time.
column6: 利用 is to make use of something to gain an advantage: 利用时间, 利用机会 (to take an opportunity). Used on people it sounds negative: 利用别人.

column4: 两个公司联合开发新产品。
column5: The two companies jointly develop new products.
column6: 联合 is to join together: 联合起来 (to unite), 联合活动 (a joint event). As an adjective it means joint.

column5: This bridge connects two cities.
column6: 连接 is to link two things so that they join: 连接起来 (to link up), 连接电脑 (to connect to a computer).

column4: 他连忙跑过去，拉住了孩子。
column5: He hurried over and caught hold of the child.
column6: 连忙 means quickly, usually in response to something that just happened: 连忙站起来 (to stand up quickly). It is for things that have already happened, so it often comes with 了.

column4: 他连续工作了十个小时。
column5: He worked for ten hours in a row.
column6: 连续 means "in a row, without a break": 连续三天 (three days in a row), 连续下雨 (to rain continuously).

column5: He does not look very well.
column6: 脸色 is the colour or look of the face, which shows health or mood: 脸色不好 (to look unwell), 脸色变了 (the face changes colour).

column3: to be in love; to date
column5: They are in love.
column6: 恋爱 is to be in a romantic relationship: 谈恋爱 (to be dating), 恋爱中 (in love). It is also a noun.

column5: Their relationship is good.
column6: 良好 is a written word for good: 良好的习惯 (a good habit), 良好的环境 (a good environment), 身体良好 (in good health).

column4: 粮食对一个国家很重要。
column5: Grain is very important for a country.
column6: 粮食 is grain and other food crops such as rice and wheat: 节约粮食 (to save food).

column5: He is an amazing person.
column6: 了不起 means "remarkable": 了不起的人, 真了不起！ (How remarkable!). 没什么了不起 means "it is nothing special".

column5: The train is about to leave.
column6: 列车 is a train, used in announcements and formal speech: 高速列车 (a high-speed train), 列车到站 (the train arrives at the station).

column5: We changed the plan at short notice.
column6: 临时 means "at the last moment" (临时改变) or "temporary" (临时工作, a temporary job).

column5: The class bell has rung.
column6: 铃 is a small bell. It is used in words: 门铃 (doorbell), 电话铃 (phone ring), 上课铃 (class bell).

column5: His thinking is very flexible.
column6: 灵活 means flexible or quick to adapt: 灵活的办法 (a flexible method), 手脚灵活 (nimble), 想法灵活 (flexible thinking).

column5: He led us to the museum.
column6: 领 means "to lead" (领路, 领着孩子) and "to receive what is yours" (领工资, to collect pay). As a noun it is a collar.

column4: 他今天戴了一条蓝领带。
column5: He wore a blue tie today.
column6: 领带 is a necktie: 一条领带, 戴领带 or 系领带 (to wear a tie; 系 is read jì here).

column5: Our leader is very good.
column6: 领导 is a leader of a team or an organisation (noun) and "to lead" (verb): 公司领导, 领导大家 (to lead everyone).

column5: Please go to the first floor to collect your gift.
column6: 领取 is to go and get something that is yours: 领取礼物, 领取工资. 领 is the short form.

column4: 这家公司在技术上领先。
column5: This company leads in technology.
column6: 领先 is to be in front: 领先一步 (one step ahead), 领先别人 (to be ahead of others).

column5: He works in the field of science.
column6: 领域 is a field of activity or knowledge: 科学领域, 教育领域 (the field of education), 各个领域 (every field).

column5: This news makes people happy.
column6: 令 is "to make, to cause", almost always as 令人 + a feeling: 令人高兴 (pleasing), 令人吃惊 (surprising).

column3: to spread; to be handed down
column4: 这个故事流传了很多年。
column5: This story has been handed down for many years.
column6: 流传 is to be passed on from person to person or from age to age: 流传下来 (to be passed down), 广泛流传 (to be widely spread).

column5: He caught the flu and is resting at home.
column6: 流感 is the flu: 得流感 (to catch the flu), 预防流感 (to prevent the flu).

column5: He is browsing the news.
column6: 浏览 is to look through quickly: 浏览网页 (to browse web pages). It is for reading on screen or flipping through.

column5: Please leave a message here.
column6: 留言 is to leave a message, and also the message itself: 给我留言 (to leave me a message), 一条留言 (a message).

column5: Chinese people think the dragon is very important.
column6: 龙 is the Chinese dragon, a lucky and powerful animal in Chinese culture. It is also one of the twelve zodiac animals.

column5: This cup leaks.
column6: 漏 means "to leak" (漏水) and "to leave out" (漏了一个字, to miss out a character).

column4: 他把老师的话录下来了。
column5: He recorded the teacher's words.
column6: 录 is to record sound or video or to write down: 录下来 (to record), 录音 (to record sound), 记录 (to write down).

column4: 船在海上走了很多天，终于看到了陆地。
column5: The ship sailed at sea for many days and finally saw land.
column6: 陆地 is dry land, as opposed to the sea: 陆地和海 (land and sea).

column5: He has been accepted by a university.
column6: 录取 is to admit someone to a school or a job after an exam or interview: 被录取 (to be admitted).

column5: Passers-by all stopped to look at him.
column6: 路人 is a person who happens to pass on the road: 向路人问路 (to ask a passer-by the way).

column4: 请告诉我去公园的路线。
column5: Please tell me the route to the park.
column6: 路线 is the way you travel: 旅游路线 (a tourist route), 走这条路线 (to take this route).

column5: The guests arrived one after another.
column6: 陆续 means one after another over a period of time: 陆续到达 (to arrive one by one). It is for a flow of people or things.

column5: I am recording.
column6: 录音 is to record sound (verb) and a recording (noun): 一段录音 (a recording), 录音机 (a recorder).

column5: I booked a plane ticket at a travel agency.
column6: 旅行社 is a travel agency: 一家旅行社, 找旅行社 (to find a travel agent).

column5: He is writing his graduation thesis.
column6: 论文 is an academic paper or thesis: 写论文 (to write a paper), 毕业论文 (a graduation thesis).

column4: 这个故事的逻辑很清楚。
column5: The logic of this story is very clear.
column6: 逻辑 is logic: 有逻辑 (logical), 逻辑清楚 (the logic is clear), 没有逻辑 (illogical).

column5: Do not scold the child.
column6: 骂 is to scold or to curse: 骂人 (to insult people), 被骂 (to be scolded). It is stronger than 批评 (to criticise).

column5: He does business.
column6: 买卖 is buying and selling, or a business: 做买卖 (to do business), 买卖很好 (business is good). It is casual, and the second syllable is neutral.

column5: This condition is hard to meet.
column6: 满足 means "to satisfy" (满足要求, to meet a requirement) and "to be content" (他很满足).

column5: He is very busy every day.
column6: 忙碌 means busy and occupied, often for a long time: 忙碌的一天 (a busy day). It sounds a little more literary than 忙.

column5: He writes with a brush.
column6: 毛笔 is the traditional Chinese brush used for writing and painting: 一支毛笔, 毛笔字 (brush writing).

column5: There is something wrong with this computer.
column6: 毛病 is a fault or a bad habit: 有毛病 (something is wrong), 改毛病 (to correct a bad habit), 小毛病 (a minor problem).

column5: There is a conflict between them.
column6: 矛盾 is a conflict or a contradiction: 有矛盾 (to have a conflict), 解决矛盾 (to solve a conflict). As an adjective it means conflicted: 很矛盾.

column3: cannot; there is no way to
column4: 这个问题我没法儿回答。
column5: I cannot answer this question.
column6: 没法儿 means "there is no way to": 没法儿说 (cannot say). It is casual and means the same as 没办法.

column5: He gave her a rose.
column6: 玫瑰 is a rose, a symbol of love. The measure word is 朵 for one flower: 一朵玫瑰.

column5: The media are all reporting this matter.
column6: 媒体 is the media: 新闻媒体 (news media), 网络媒体 (online media). It is used as a group noun.

column5: He likes art class.
column6: 美术 is fine art such as painting and drawing: 美术课 (art class), 美术老师 (art teacher).

column5: This is a delicious dinner.
column6: 美味 is a written word for delicious: 美味的菜 (a delicious dish), 美味的食物. As a noun it means a delicacy.

column5: She is very charming.
column6: 魅力 is the power to attract people: 有魅力 (charming), 个人魅力 (personal charm), 城市的魅力 (a city's charm).

column5: He is going to the hospital outpatient clinic today.
column6: 门诊 is outpatient treatment, for people who do not stay in hospital: 看门诊 (to see a doctor as an outpatient). 急诊 is for emergencies.

column3: to be fascinated by; to be lost
column5: He has become crazy about football.
column6: 迷 means "to be fascinated" (迷上, 球迷 a fan, 迷人 charming) and "to lose one's way" (迷路).

column5: I got lost in the mountains.
column6: 迷路 is to lose one's way. It is a verb plus object, so it splits: 迷了路.

column4: 这是我们两个人的秘密。
column5: This is a secret between the two of us.
column6: 秘密 is a secret: 有秘密 (to have a secret), 保守秘密 (to keep a secret). As an adjective it means secret: 秘密会议.

column5: The relationship between the two countries is very close.
column6: 密切 means close and frequent: 关系密切 (a close relationship), 密切联系 (close contact), 密切注意 (to watch closely).

column5: She is the company manager's secretary.
column6: 秘书 is a secretary or personal assistant: 当秘书 (to work as a secretary), 经理的秘书.

column5: The area of this country is very large.
column6: 面积 is the size of a surface: 面积很大 (a large area), 房子的面积 (the floor area of a house).

column3: to face; to be confronted with
column5: We face great difficulties.
column6: 面临 is to face something serious, a problem or a choice: 面临困难 (to face difficulties), 面临选择 (to face a choice).

column3: to face; to be aimed at
column5: This house faces the south.
column6: 面向 means "to face towards" (面向南) and "to be aimed at" (这个节目面向孩子, this programme is aimed at children).

column5: Please describe your home.
column6: 描述 is to describe in words: 描述得很清楚 (described very clearly), 描述一下 (to describe a little).

column5: He is very sensitive to sounds.
column6: 敏感 means quick to react: 对……很敏感 (to be sensitive to …), 敏感的问题 (a sensitive issue).

column4: 请写下这个商店的名称。
column5: Please write down the name of this shop.
column6: 名称 is the name of a thing, a place or an organisation, not a person: 公司名称 (the company name). 名字 is the everyday word.
